lines.text: Many learners say: I have a doubt about this word.
Better: I have a question about this word.
Doubt means you are not sure.
Question! I have a question about the test.

data.wrong: I have a doubt about this word.
data.right: I have a question about this word.
data.why: Doubt means you are not sure.

quiz.stem: I have a ___ about the test.

native.tip: “Doubt” é desconfiar. Para tirar dúvida, tenha uma “question”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I have a doubt about this word.”. O certo é “I have a question about this word.”. Na sala de aula, esse erro aparece o tempo todo. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “question”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: “Doubt” means to distrust. To ask for help, you have a “question”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I have a doubt about this word.”. The right way is “I have a question about this word.”. This mistake shows up in class all the time. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
